hook: He answered an ad to be eaten alive.
narration:
He answered an ad to be eaten alive.

His name was Bernd Brandes. He was forty-three. A quiet engineer from Berlin.

He found the post on a cannibalism forum. The poster called himself Armin Meiwes. Armin wanted a willing victim. Bernd wrote back the same night.

On March ninth, two thousand one, Bernd took the train to Armin's farmhouse. Armin set up a camera in the kitchen. He recorded everything that happened next.

At Bernd's request, Armin cut off his penis first. They tried to cook it together. Neither of them could eat it.

Then Armin killed him. He butchered the body over the next ten months. He ate more than forty pounds of Bernd's meat.

Police only caught Armin because he posted again... looking for a second volunteer. He got life in prison. Would you have answered the ad?
